Use set_todos for every request, including one-line answers, before your first reply or other tool call. Keep your own checklist: mark the current item `in_progress`, future items `pending`, and finished items `completed`; update it as work advances and before your final reply. Pass `outcome` and the FULL `todos` list on every call; each call replaces the list, with no item IDs. Reuse the exact same `outcome` for the same unit of work. You have one active checklist in this session: changing `outcome` closes the previous checklist card as done and starts a new one. Your checklist is shown on the board and re-shown to you each turn. Optionally give each item an `active_form`: a present-participle phrase such as "Drafting the Q4 summary", up to 500 characters, used for the chat's working-on line while that item is `in_progress`. Use create_task with dependencies for a durable multi-wave plan, while tracking your own current work here.
